title: AWS Network High Availability: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: Picture a hot dog cart with one stand. If that stand is shut, there are no sales. Run several, in different places.

scenes.heading: The hot dog carts
scenes.narration: A few ideas keep services running. One availability zone is a single point of failure. So spread across at least two zones. A load balancer shares traffic between healthy targets. It doesn't cache or change the data.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. Use at least two. It doesn't cache. It only uses healthy targets.

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.cta: Try the Courseiva AWS high availability lab
scenes.narration: So, to recap. Use at least two zones. A load balancer spreads traffic. It skips unhealthy targets. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva AWS high availability lab.
